title: Tavi

paragraphs: She was Rabbi Chiyya’s daughter, born a twin with her sister Pazi, as in Yevamot 65b. Hyman says he has already explained in the entry Rabbi Chiyya that she was betrothed to the son of our holy Rabbi and died before the wedding.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The first-person cross-reference is Hyman speaking about his Rabbi Chiyya entry. Yevamot 65b in the William Davidson digital edition names Pazi and Tavi alongside Yehudah and Chizkiyah; the betrothal claim remains Hyman’s cross-referenced account.

The checked Yevamot context names the sisters Pazi and Tavi in the Chiyya and Judith narrative. The fuller biographical cross-reference and the report about betrothal and death remain Hyman’s account; the entire separate Chiyya entry has not been independently collated here.
